info.description: A comprehensive social application backend API built with Go and Gin framework. Provides endpoints for user management, authentication, posts, comments, categories, roles, and friend management.
info.title: Filia Project Backend API

get.description: Returns a welcome message for the API
Returns a welcome message for the authentication endpoint

Redirects user to Google OAuth consent screen

post.description: Validates credentials and returns a JWT token
Validates input, hashes password, assigns default role, and creates user in the database
post.summary: Register a new user with email and password

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all categories in the system

parameters.description: Number of categories to return (default: 10, max: 200)
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Creates a new category with optional parent category (requires moderator:create permission)

get.description: Searches for a category by its name (authenticated endpoint)
Returns detailed information about a specific category

put.description: Updates category name and/or parent (requires moderator:update permission)

delete.description: Permanently deletes a category and its related usages (requires moderator:delete permission)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of posts belonging to a specific category

parameters.description: Number of posts to return (default: 10, max: 200)
parameters.name: limit

400.description: Invalid category ID or query parameters

get.description: Returns detailed information about a specific comment

put.description: Updates the content of an existing comment (requires user:update permission)

delete.description: Permanently deletes a comment (requires user:update permission)

post.description: Toggles the like status for a comment. If already liked, removes the like (requires user:update permission)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of posts with optional filtering for authenticated users

parameters.description: Number of posts to return (default: 20, max: 200)
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Creates a new post with title, content, categories, tags, and tagged users

get.description: Returns detailed information about a specific post

put.description: Updates the content, title, categories, tags, or privacy settings of a post

delete.description: Permanently deletes a post from the system

get.description: Returns all comments associated with a specific post

post.description: Creates a new comment on a specific post
Toggles the like status for a post. If already liked, removes the like.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all roles in the system (requires moderator:read permission)

post.description: Creates a new role with specified permissions (requires moderator:update permission)

get.description: Returns the role information for the currently authenticated user

delete.description: Permanently deletes a role from the system (requires admin:access permission)

get.description: Returns a list of all users in the system (public endpoint)

post.description: Sends a friend request to a user by their email address (requires user:update permission)

get.description: Returns all pending friend requests received by the authenticated user (requires user:update permission)
Returns all friend requests sent by the authenticated user (requires user:update permission)
Returns the user information for the currently authenticated user

post.description: Uploads a new profile picture for the authenticated user

put.description: Updates email, password, or full name. Requires old password confirmation.
